Traps that cost time:
- ddocs `set` writes JSON with 2-space indent and drops `"references": []`; docs/project uses tabs: run node_modules/.bin/biome format --write (needs `just worktree-deps` in a fresh worktree). docs/plans and .dd/schemas are biome-excluded and use 2 spaces.
- ddocs ignores unknown field types: `boolean` is NOT enforced. Use an enum.
- builder/plan ids must be <prefix>-NNNN hex (ph-0001, ac-0001, bp-0001); states are unchecked|checked|...
- Generate .dd.md (ddocs build) BEFORE `git add`, or the renderings stay untracked.
- coverage-check (a harness checks stage) refuses any blueprint component no workstream step builds and has no exemptions: a shared blueprint grows one PRD at a time (blueprint 005 d-6).
- A link to a PRD not yet on the branch fails ddocs validate.
- Python patch scripts: run cargo fmt AFTER patching, and match text as fmt wrote it; heredocs with `{...}` or `<...>` sometimes get blocked by the shell guard: write the script to the session files dir instead.
- `pij-rs ping .data.spawns` counts EVERY daemon launch (git and ddocs too), so any governance commit moves it.
- Main's CI flakes on harness/scripts/shared-build.test.ts F273 and an http cold-wake test; rerun the failed job.
